pick.name: Haybale the Bobtail Cat
pick.description: Haybale, a sandy-buff cat with tufted ears, dark-spotted legs, a white belly and a stubby black-tipped tail, naps atop the garden gate at dusk. A cat coin priced in ANDURIL. Not affiliated with Anduril Industries, PreStocks or StonkFun. No intrinsic value; not financial advice.
